## Summary Build StockRoom from an empty repo: a NestJS + Prisma/Postgres API with JWT auth and clerk/manager roles, an Angular standalone-component frontend, atomic per-location stock movement processing, a low-stock report, a filterable movement audit log, and demo seed data. ## Scope ### Files to create **Root** - `docker-compose.yml` — local dev: postgres 16, backend, frontend - `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore` - `k8s/postgres.yaml`, `k8s/backend.yaml`, `k8s/frontend.yaml` — Deployment + Service per component; backend gets `DATABASE_URL`/`JWT_SECRET` from a Secret; frontend Service is the ingress target **Backend — `backend/`** - `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.env.example` - `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: `npm ci` → `npx prisma generate` → `npm run build` → runtime stage copying `dist/`, `node_modules`, `prisma/`; entrypoint runs `prisma migrate deploy && node dist/prisma/seed.js && node dist/main.js` - `prisma/schema.prisma`, `prisma/seed.ts`, `prisma/migrations/…` - `src/main.ts` — global `ValidationPipe({whitelist,transform})`, global prefix `api`, CORS - `src/app.module.ts` - `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts` - `src/health/health.module.ts`, `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/health/deep` (`SELECT 1`) - `src/auth/auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `public.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/signup.dto.ts` - `src/users/users.module.ts`, `users.service.ts` - `src/items/items.module.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`, `dto/query-items.dto.ts` - `src/locations/locations.module.ts`, `locations.controller.ts`, `locations.service.ts`, `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts` - `src/movements/movements.module.ts`, `movements.controller.ts`, `movements.service.ts`, `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts` - `src/reports/reports.module.ts`, `reports.controller.ts`, `reports.service.ts` - `src/common/filters/prisma-exception.filter.ts` — maps P2002 → 409/422 - `test/*.e2e-spec.ts` — one file per spec Requirement **Frontend — `frontend/`** - `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.app.json` - `Dockerfile` — build stage `npm ci && npx ng build --configuration production`; nginx stage `COPY --from=build /app/dist/frontend/browser /usr/share/nginx/html` - `nginx.conf` — SPA fallback `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html`; `location /api/ { proxy_pass http://stockroom-backend:3000; }` - `src/index.html` (`StockRoom`), `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.css` - `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))` - `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/app.component.ts` (shell + nav, renders "StockRoom") - `src/app/core/auth.service.ts`, `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `role.guard.ts`, `models.ts` - `src/app/core/api/items.service.ts`, `locations.service.ts`, `movements.service.ts`, `reports.service.ts` - Pages: `pages/login/`, `pages/signup/`, `pages/items/item-list/`, `item-detail/`, `item-form/`, `pages/locations/location-list/`, `location-form/`, `pages/movements/movement-form/`, `movement-log/`, `pages/reports/low-stock/`, `pages/forbidden/` ### Files to modify - `README.md` — setup, demo credentials, architecture ### Dependencies - Backend: `@nestjs/common|core|platform-express|config|jwt|passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `bcryptjs`; dev: `typescript`, `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node` - Frontend: `@angular/core|common|router|forms|platform-browser` (v20 standalone), `rxjs`, `zone.js`; dev: `@angular/cli`, `@angular/build`, `typescript` - Infra: Postgres 16, nginx:alpine, node:22-alpine ### Integrations None — the spec declares no third-party services. ### Assumptions - Angular 20 standalone components + signals, functional guards/interceptors (no NgModules) — greenfield, so current idiomatic Angular. - JWT access token (12h) in `localStorage`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. No refresh token — matches the demo scope. - Roles are a Prisma enum `Role { clerk manager }`; `manager` is a strict superset of `clerk` permissions. - Signup assigns `manager` if the `User` table is empty, else `clerk`. Seeds run first, so real signups are clerks. - Low-stock predicate: `SUM(StockLevel.qty) <= Item.reorderAt`, evaluated across all locations. - `qty` is a positive integer; movements never accept zero or negative. - Duplicate SKU returns **422** with a field-level error (spec says "validation error"); SKU is stored uppercase-trimmed. - Item deletion is blocked (409) when movements reference it; locations likewise when stock is non-zero. - Audit log and item list are paginated (`page`, `pageSize`, default 25) and bound to query params. - Movement records are immutable — no update/delete endpoints. ## Implementation Plan ### Step 1: Repo scaffold and infra **Files:** `docker-compose.yml`, `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`, `k8s/*.yaml` **Change:** Postgres service with a named volume; backend on `:3000`; frontend nginx on `:80` proxying `/api`. K8s manifests mirror this with readiness probes hitting `/api/health` (backend) and `/` (frontend). ### Step 2: Prisma schema and migration **File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma` **Change:** Define the spec's data model verbatim. - `User(id, email @unique, passwordHash, role Role, createdAt)` - `Item(id, sku @unique, name, description, unit, reorderAt Int, createdAt, updatedAt)` - `Location(id, name, zone, createdAt)` with `@@unique([name, zone])` - `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0))` with `@@unique([itemId, locationId])`, `@@index([locationId])` - `Movement(id, type MovementType, itemId, fromLocId String?, toLocId String?, qty Int, note String?, userId, createdAt)` with `@@index([itemId, createdAt])`, `@@index([createdAt])` - `enum Role { clerk manager }`, `enum MovementType { IN OUT TRANSFER }` Generate the initial migration. ### Step 3: Prisma service + health **Files:** `backend/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `backend/src/health/health.controller.ts` **Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit`. Health controller marked `@Public()`; `/api/health` returns `{status:'ok'}`, `/api/health/deep` runs `$queryRaw\`SELECT 1\`` and returns db status, 503 on failure. ### Step 4: Auth module **Files:** `backend/src/auth/*`, `backend/src/users/users.service.ts` **Change:** - `POST /api/auth/login` → verify bcrypt hash, sign JWT `{sub, email, role}`, return `{accessToken, user}`; 401 on bad credentials. - `POST /api/auth/signup` → 422 on duplicate email; role per Assumptions; returns same shape. - `GET /api/auth/me` → current user from token. - `JwtAuthGuard` registered as an `APP_GUARD`, bypassed by `@Public()` — this makes **401 the default for every data endpoint**, satisfying the unauthenticated-API scenario without per-controller wiring. - `RolesGuard` as a second `APP_GUARD` reading `@Roles('manager')`; throws 403. ### Step 5: Items module **Files:** `backend/src/items/*` **Change:** - `GET /api/items` (any role) — returns each item with `totalQty` (aggregated from `StockLevel`), supports `q`, `lowStock`, `page`, `pageSize`. - `GET /api/items/:id` (any role) — item plus `stockLevels[]` (`{locationId, locationName, zone, qty}`) and `totalQty`; the breakdown sums to the total by construction. - `POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/items` — `@Roles('manager')`. Create DTO validates `sku` (non-empty), `name`, `unit`, `reorderAt >= 0`, optional `description`. Duplicate SKU caught via the P2002 filter → 422. ### Step 6: Locations module **Files:** `backend/src/locations/*` **Change:** `GET /api/locations` for any role (populates the movement form's selector); `POST/PATCH/DELETE` restricted to `@Roles('manager')`. Validate `name`, `zone` non-empty. ### Step 7: Movements module — the transactional core **File:** `backend/src/movements/movements.service.ts` **Change:** `POST /api/movements` (any authenticated role) runs one `prisma.$transaction(async tx => …)`: 1. DTO-level validation by type: `IN` requires `toLocId` and forbids `fromLocId`; `OUT` requires `fromLocId` only; `TRANSFER` requires both and `fromLocId !== toLocId`. `qty` is `@IsInt() @Min(1)`. 2. Verify item and referenced locations exist (404 otherwise). 3. Upsert the affected `StockLevel` rows, then re-read them with `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` ordered by `id` (deterministic lock order → no deadlock under concurrent movements). 4. For `OUT`/`TRANSFER`, if `source.qty < qty` throw `UnprocessableEntityException('Insufficient stock')` — the transaction rolls back, so the stored balance is untouched (spec: 5 units stays 5). 5. Apply deltas: `IN` → `+qty` at `toLoc`; `OUT` → `-qty` at `fromLoc`; `TRANSFER` → `-qty` at `fromLoc` and `+qty` at `toLoc` (total conserved). 6. Create the `Movement` row with `userId` from the JWT and DB-generated `createdAt`. `GET /api/movements` — `@Roles('manager')`, filters `itemId`, `type`, `from`, `to` (ISO dates, `from` inclusive / `to` end-of-day inclusive), paginated, `createdAt desc`, includes `user.email`, `item.sku/name`, and both location names. ### Step 8: Low-stock report **File:** `backend/src/reports/reports.service.ts` **Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock` — `@Roles('manager')`. Group `StockLevel` by `itemId` summing `qty`, left-joined so items with no stock rows count as 0, filter `total <= reorderAt`, order by `(total - reorderAt)` ascending. Returns `{item, totalQty, reorderAt, deficit}`. ### Step 9: Seed **File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts` **Change:** Idempotent upserts — `manager@demo` (manager) and `clerk@demo` (clerk), both bcrypt `Demo1234!`; 3 locations (`Zone A`, `Zone B`, `Zone C`); 8 items `SKU-001`…`SKU-008` with varied `unit`/`reorderAt`. Seed stock by **calling the movement service logic**, not by writing `StockLevel` directly, so the audit log is non-empty and balances are consistent. Ensure ≥2 items land at or below `reorderAt` so the low-stock report is non-empty on first load. ### Step 10: Angular shell, routing, auth plumbing **Files:** `frontend/src/app/app.routes.ts`, `app.component.ts`, `core/*` **Change:** `AuthService` holds a `currentUser` signal hydrated from `localStorage`, exposes `login/signup/logout/isManager`. `authInterceptor` attaches the bearer token and routes 401 → `/login?returnUrl=…`, 403 → `/403`. `authGuard` and `roleGuard(['manager'])` are functional guards. Every navigable state is URL-addressable, each route carrying `data.flow`: | Route | Access | State in URL | |---|---|---| | `/login`, `/signup` | public | `?returnUrl=` | | `/items` | clerk+ | `?q=&lowStock=&page=` | | `/items/new`, `/items/:id/edit` | manager | — | | `/items/:id` | clerk+ | `?tab=stock\|history` | | `/locations` | manager | `?page=` | | `/locations/new`, `/locations/:id/edit` | manager | — | | `/movements/new` | clerk+ | `?itemId=&type=` prefill | | `/movements` (audit log) | manager | `?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=` | | `/reports/low-stock` | manager | — | | `/403` | authed | — | | `/` | — | redirect → `/items` (guard bounces anonymous users to `/login`) | Delete confirmations use `?modal=confirm-delete&id=` rather than component state. All list components read filters from `ActivatedRoute.queryParamMap` and write changes back via `router.navigate([], {queryParams, queryParamsHandling:'merge'})`, so every filtered view is deep-linkable and restorable. ### Step 11: Auth views and the smoke marker **Files:** `pages/login/`, `pages/signup/`, `app.component.ts`, `index.html` **Change:** Login renders an `

StockRoom

` brand block above the form; the authenticated shell header renders the same string. Since `/` redirects anonymous visitors to `/login`, the string "StockRoom" is present in rendered content for the Playwright oracle whether or not a session exists. Login form has email/password with inline error on 401; signup mirrors it. ### Step 12: Catalog and location views **Files:** `pages/items/*`, `pages/locations/*` **Change:** Item list table shows `sku`, `name`, `unit`, `reorderAt`, `totalQty`, with a low-stock badge when `totalQty <= reorderAt`. Create/Edit/Delete controls render only when `auth.isManager()` and their routes are `roleGuard`-protected server-side and client-side. Item detail shows the per-location breakdown table with a total row. Item form surfaces the 422 duplicate-SKU error against the SKU field. Location list/form are manager-only. ### Step 13: Movement entry and audit log **Files:** `pages/movements/*` **Change:** Movement form: type selector (`IN`/`OUT`/`TRANSFER`) that reactively shows/hides the from/to location selects, item select, qty, note. Shows the server's insufficient-stock 422 as a form-level error. On success, navigates to `/items/:id`. Audit log (manager) is a filterable table — item select, type select, date-range inputs, all bound to query params — showing user email, item, type, qty, from/to, and formatted timestamp. ### Step 14: Low-stock report view **File:** `pages/reports/low-stock/` **Change:** Manager-only table of items at or below threshold with on-hand, reorderAt, deficit, and a link to `/movements/new?itemId=…&type=IN`. Empty state when nothing is low. ## Testing Strategy - **Backend e2e (supertest, one file per Requirement)** — the spec's scenarios map 1:1 to test cases: clerk/manager login both succeed; clerk `POST /api/items` → 403; anonymous `GET /api/items` → 401; duplicate SKU → 422 with item count unchanged; `IN` 50 → balance 50; `OUT` 20 → balance 30; `TRANSFER` 10 → 20/10 with total conserved; `OUT` 10 against 5 → 422 with balance still 5; reorderAt 10 / 12 on hand / `OUT` 5 → item present in low-stock; reorderAt 10 / 40 on hand → absent; audit log lists user+item+type+qty+timestamp and honours item and date-range filters. - **Concurrency test** — fire two simultaneous `OUT` movements that would jointly overdraw one location; exactly one must succeed, and the final balance must never go negative. - **Frontend** — `ng build --configuration production` must pass; unit tests for `authGuard`/`roleGuard` redirect behaviour and for query-param round-tripping on the audit-log filters. - **Smoke** — `docker compose up`, load `/` unauthenticated, assert "StockRoom" is in the rendered content (mirrors the Playwright oracle); then log in as each seeded account and walk the manager-only routes to confirm the guards. ## Risks - **Seeded demo credentials** are hardcoded and well-known; acceptable for the demo scope but must not reach a real deployment. `JWT_SECRET` must come from a K8s Secret, never a default in code. - **Race conditions on balances** are the highest-risk area. Mitigated by `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` in deterministic id order inside the transaction; the upsert-then-lock ordering matters — locking before the row exists would not prevent a concurrent insert, which is why upsert comes first and the `@@unique([itemId, locationId])` constraint backstops it. - **Docker and psql are not installed on this machine**, so container and migration steps cannot be verified locally; they will first execute in the Colossus pipeline. Backend tests should therefore be runnable against a `DATABASE_URL` pointing at any reachable Postgres. - **The Colossus deploy pipeline's expected layout is undiscoverable** from this repo — the workflow just POSTs a webhook. The `backend/` + `frontend/` + `k8s/` layout is a conventional guess; if the pipeline expects different paths or image names, the manifests will need adjustment on first deploy. - **Nginx `proxy_pass` hardcodes the backend service name** (`stockroom-backend`); it must match the K8s Service name in `k8s/backend.yaml` or all API calls 502. - **Deleting a location that still holds stock** would silently orphan quantities; guarded by a 409, but the frontend must surface that error rather than assuming success.
